name: ui
title: New UI Toolkit
description: Creates an empty UI toolkit folder structure for a React, Angular, HTML, or other project type. Includes toolkit settings, usage rules, project and component scaffold folders, and CSS container-atom, action-atom, effect-atom, and grid-atom folders.

settings.name: folder
settings.title: Toolkit Folder
settings.description: Absolute destination folder. A new folder or an existing empty folder is accepted.

settings.name: type
settings.title: Project Type
settings.description: Lowercase project type used beneath tools/, such as react, angular, or html.

settings.name: name
settings.title: Toolkit Name
settings.description: Optional lowercase toolkit name. Defaults to the destination folder name.

settings.name: title
settings.title: Toolkit Title
settings.description: Optional display title. Defaults to the project type followed by UI Toolkit.

settings.name: description
settings.title: Toolkit Description
settings.description: Optional description for the new toolkit.
